If sentiment is strongly bullish (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overreaction.  
If sentiment is strongly bearish (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to offset pessimism.  
In mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33), apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment to align with historical mean reversion.  
In late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is bullish (≥0.67), apply a 0.5–1.0% upward adjustment to capture momentum continuation.  
If sentiment swings sharply (±0.33) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast volatility by 20–30% in mid-horizon to reflect sentiment uncertainty.  
If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over 5+ days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% in late-horizon to anticipate sustained trend.
